description: This file is a PHP script embedded in an XHTML page that interacts with device configuration parameters related to NAT port mappings and DMZ settings. It includes functions to get, set, add, and delete configuration objects and displays the results in HTML format.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple string parameters associated with a root object in the device configuration.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple string parameters under a root object in the device configuration.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of instance IDs under a specified object.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object instance under specified table.
